assembly: Print shore, inner and outer once each; print each numbered boat twice. Mark A and B on each player’s two boats. Lower carriers onto shore and place boats in berths.
limitations: Digital geometry and rule simulations only; no physical print, fit, durability or human enjoyment claim.
The twelve-round rules were simulated; six- and eighteen-round variants were not separately simulated.
Five-player synchronized policies remain a documented balance concern.
safety: Small parts: keep away from children under three.
Use a level table; lift carriers and counters separately for transport.
An adult should cut cards and remove print burrs.
summary: Steer two shared currents together, carry your rivals into crowded harbors, and cross lanes for the next surprise. A simultaneous tabletop game for family evenings.
title: Crosscurrent
